messages:
Nina Gomez: Heads-up: applied a tighter egress policy in eu-west to enforce KMS call limits. Seeing GPU nodes in the warmpool fail to finish onboarding. Some nodes stuck at 'awaiting-keystore' state.
Omar Rahman: I can see API errors from the node bootstrap: 403 from kms-eu-west-1 for decrypt calls. IAM condition on the new role blocks requests from the ephemeral role session.
Priya Singh: That will block the keystore fetch which halts node init. Warmpool marks as unhealthy and drains; we then re-create which causes churn.
Ben Liu: Latency impact is small p50 but visible p99 spikes because cold starts happen more often after eviction. Also noticed an uptick in KMS retry traffic from the cluster, probably due to repeated bootstrap attempts.
Nina Gomez: Why did the IAM condition get added? Was this related to the compliance sprint?
Priya Singh: Yes, we rolled a policy requiring sourceVpc in the KMS grant for stronger isolation. The problem is our bootstrap uses privnet endpoints that NAT through a different subnet than the one listed.
Omar Rahman: Quick mitigation: remove the sourceVpc condition on the keystore grant or add the privnet NAT subnet to the grant. I can patch the grant to include the ephemeral subnet range for 30m.
ops-bot: [alert] eu-west: node-bootstrap-failures increased 6x after keystore policy change. Runbook infra-boot-01 suggested.
Nina Gomez: Do the patch but add an audit entry. We need a one-off exception with justification logged. Also Priya please add the NAT subnet to the dependency manifest so future policy rollouts validate keystore bootstrap.
Priya Singh: Will add a CD check to the firewall/iam pipeline: simulate a bootstrap and confirm KMS decrypt succeeds from a test ENI. If fails, rollback.
Ben Liu: Suggest also throttling bootstrap retries on the agent side to reduce repeated KMS hits during policy flaps. Backoff from 2s -> 60s and cap attempts to 3.
Omar Rahman: Patch applied to KMS grant (added 10.200.44.0/24) and temporary exception logged: ticket INFRA-9876. Nodes are progressing through keystore step.
ops-bot: [info] KMS grant updated; exception INFRA-9876 recorded.
Nina Gomez: Thanks. Next steps: 1) Priya to add e2e bootstrap check in deploy gate 2) Ben to adjust bootstrap retry backoff 3) schedule a retro on rollouts that modify KMS grants.
Priya Singh: I'll schedule a 30m sync today.
Ben Liu: Will open a tiny PR for the backoff change.
Nina Gomez: Closing loop: once all warm nodes healthy please post a short cost estimate for the churn (GPU hours + KMS request cost).
